name: git-branchline
description: A live Git history pane beside the chat: branches, tags, HEAD, and how each branch stands against main

foldQuietStretches.title: Fold quiet stretches
foldQuietStretches.description: Fold runs of commits with no branch, tag or merge into one row. auto: only when the graph does not fit the pane. Hover a folded row to see its commits.

showTagOnlyCommits.title: Show tag-only commits
showTagOnlyCommits.description: Also draw commits that only a tag keeps, such as builds tagged on merges that never landed on a branch.
